t: The second sentence of section 2502 of title 7, Canal Zone Code, is amended by striking out, after “persons”, the word “at”, and in lieu thereof inserting “as”.

fable.w: This section is a purely technical amendment that replaces the word "at" with "as" in a provision of the Canal Zone Code. The word "persons" might suggest outside parties are involved, but the text sets up no consultation, hearing, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue, so no one outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision.
